authority: T0 C0-A calibration certificate; not a TECT claim, physical time-emergence theorem, or cosmology
statement: An entrywise-nonnegative reversible finite-state Markov kernel P that is strictly positive definite on L2(X,pi), together with an inserted spacing a, uniquely determines the nonnegative self-adjoint generator H_a=-(1/a)log P and its unitary group. The exact three-state fixture has spectrum {1,2/3,2/3}, one-dimensional constant ground space, and gap log(3/2)/a. A reversible entrywise-nonnegative control with eigenvalue -1/10 violates link-reflection positivity, while the zero-spectrum control remains link-positive but has no finite logarithmic generator. Time order, reflection, spacing, and the full transfer are declared C0-A inputs; space, a causal cone, a field state, and Pre-A are not reconstructed.

general_theorem.space: finite X with at least two points, pi_x>0, sum pi_x=1, and complex Hilbert space L2(X,pi;C)
general_theorem.transfer_conditions: P1=1, P_xy>=0, pi_x P_xy=pi_y P_yx, and 0<P<=I on L2(X,pi)
general_theorem.condition_independence: entrywise Markov positivity and operator positivity are logically independent and both are assumed
general_theorem.inserted_time_data: ordered transfer steps, reflection, and a>0
general_theorem.irreducible_ground_state: ker(H_a)=span{1}; the ground-state ray is unique and its normalized strictly-positive real representative is 1

fixture.static_nonidentifiability: the same pi with alpha=1/2 gives a distinct positive transfer and gap log(2)/a

reflection_positivity.site: for a stationary reversible Markov path, E[conj(F(theta X))F(X)]=sum_x pi_x|E[F|X0=x]|^2>=0
reflection_positivity.link: the reflected link form is <h,Ph>_pi for h(x)=E[F|X1=x] and requires P>=0
reflection_positivity.negative_control: alpha=-1/10 leaves an entrywise nonnegative reversible stochastic transfer but gives spectrum {1,-1/10,-1/10} and a negative link form
reflection_positivity.zero_spectrum_control: alpha=0 gives an irreducible entrywise-positive reversible link-positive transfer with spectrum {1,0,0}, but no finite self-adjoint logarithmic generator
reflection_positivity.operator_positive_non_markov_control: for uniform pi and v=(1,1,-2), P=I-(1/10)vv^T has spectrum {1,1,2/5} but P_12=-1/10

mathematical_status.reversibility_without_operator_positivit: EXCLUDED as sufficient for a positive logarithmic generator
mathematical_status.spatial_locality_and_causal_cone: OPEN and absent from the finite fixture

inserted_inputs: finite state set and positive one-time probability
the full reversible positive transfer P
derived_outputs: weighted Hilbert space and positive self-adjoint logarithmic generator
one-dimensional constant ground space and finite gap in the irreducible fixture
failure of reversibility alone at a negative transfer eigenvalue and the distinct zero-spectrum finite-log boundary

prior_art_boundary: Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction is established prior art. This package is a finite exact calibration and a TECT interface gate, not a novelty claim for reflection-positive reconstruction.
no_overclaim: This finite-state C0-A benchmark reconstructs a nonnegative self-adjoint generator and a unitary group only after an entrywise-Markov, reversible, strictly operator-positive transfer, time ordering, reflection, and spacing are supplied. It does not derive time, an arrow, spatial locality, Lorentzian signature, a null cone, light speed, a physical quantum theory, a Hadamard state, gravity, an event horizon, cosmic cooling, the PA-H1 to PA-M2 interface, a physical TECT branch choice, or Pre-A completion.
